name: Melted church candles
description: A cluster of seven pale wax church candles of different heights, from 0.08 to 0.3 m, standing on the floor in a shared puddle of hardened wax about 0.4 m across. Wax drips run down their sides and small dark wicks sit in their melted tops.

provenance.prompt: A cluster of melted church candles on the floor about 0.4 m across: seven pale wax candles of different heights from 0.08 to 0.3 m, with drips and a shared puddle of hardened wax around their feet, small dark wicks on top.
